verdict.rationale: The closest scoped agent credential is the ACP delegated payment token: a single-use Braintree nonce "bound to your merchant ID" with configurable "amount and time restrictions" (paypal-ac-supp-acp-chatgpt, paypal-ac-supp-agent-ready). However, that is a buyer payment credential, not an API credential a user issues to an agent. The general API surface uses OAuth 2 access tokens (paypal-ac-supp-rest-overview), and the remote MCP server requires OAuth bearer auth, but it advertises only openid/email/profile scopes (paypal-ac-probe-rt-1), so there is no evidence of fine-grained API scoping. Missing for 10: user-issued agent-specific API keys or tokens, per-tool or per-API permission scopes for toolkit/MCP access, least-privilege credential management docs, and independent corroboration.
